youtube.title: Candlestick Chart Kaise Padhein? 45 Second Mein Seekho #Shorts
youtube.description:
Candlestick chart padhna seekho 45 second mein: open, high, low, close, body aur wick ka matlab, green aur red candle kab banti hai, aur lambi wick kya batati hai.

Is video ke numbers:
• Example candle (sirf samjhane ke liye): open ₹100, high ₹107, low ₹95, close ₹105 = green candle, upar chhoti wick, neeche lambi wick
• OHLC basics: body = open se close; wick = din ka high aur low

Aapko chart pe sabse confusing kya lagta hai? 👇

caption:
Har candle ek kahani hai 🕯️

Ek candle = 4 cheezein: Open, High, Low, Close
• Body = open se close
• Wick = din ka high aur low
• Close > Open = GREEN (buyers jeete)
• Close < Open = RED (sellers jeete)

Example: ₹100 open, ₹107 high, ₹95 low, ₹105 close = green candle, neeche lambi wick (price gaya, par tik nahi paaya).

Yaad rakho: candle future nahi batati, bas batati hai kya hua.

Save karo, chart kholte waqt kaam aayega. Sabse confusing kya lagta hai? 👇
